messages:
jonathan: Heads-up — ran into a noisy deprecation banner storm on staging. Hundreds of clients hit it during the probe run and it spiked console DB writes and alerts. :grimacing:
maria: ugh, that explains the alerts i saw. was that the v1->v2 probe? what triggered the banner for so many tenants?
jonathan: our current rule is any tenant with a >0.1% v1 traffic sample in the last 24h gets the banner. during the synthetic probe the sampling momentarily crossed that threshold for lots of shadow tenants.
maria: maybe we need a "quiet mode" for probes — a console toggle that suppresses visible banners but still emits telemetry. keep UX calm while we collect signals.
ashley: I like quiet mode. product wants to avoid end-customer UX noise during experiments. but ops also needs clear signals when we do real deprecations. can we make it scoped? per-tenant + global?
ravi: technical constraints: banners are written by the console service which cascades to the UI and to the banner audit log. we can add a flag that short-circuits UI publish but still emits an event to telemetry. implementation is straightforward but watch for double-counting in our analytics pipeline.
jonathan: exactly — the main risk is we silently stop logging to the banner table and later lose provenance for manual rollbacks. proposal: quiet mode = "suppress_ui": true, "log_event": true, "audit_stream": optional. default for probes: suppress_ui true and audit_stream off.
maria: can we make quiet mode timeboxed? e.g., auto-expire after X hours so we don't accidentally leave tenants in quiet forever.
ravi: yep. add expiry and actor metadata. also we should mark events with sampling_policy so downstream metrics know these were probe-sampled, e.g., sample_policy:probe_v2_2026-03.
ashley: what about billing/quota effects? banners currently trigger a quota check path and sometimes change per-route telemetry sampling. if we suppress UI but still hit quota code, customers might see side effects without explanation.
jonathan: good catch. idea: route quiet-mode probes through a parallel "probe" path that emits telemetry but bypasses quota-enforcement side effects. we already have a shadow route for canaries; reuse that.
maria: ok draft implementation from infra perspective? rough config please so we can review with product.
ravi: draft flag config (console service):
```
{
  "quiet_mode": true,
  "suppress_ui": true,
  "emit_telemetry": true,
  "audit_stream": "disabled",
  "expiry_ts": 1752464830,
  "actor": "experiment/team-alpha",
  "sample_policy": "probe_v2_2026-03"
}
```
jonathan: looks good. add a reason field and a trace_id so we can tie UI-suppressed events back to the original deploy run.
ravi: +1 for trace_id. also propose a small-rate cap on telemetry events so probe storms don't flood our event bus. recommended 1000 events/min per team by default.
maria: can console dashboard show a separate "probe-only" panel that surfaces these suppressed events for internal users only? product wants to be able to see what would have shown up without exposing banners.
ashley: yes — add a toggle in the deprecations dashboard: Show -> [all | visible-only | probe-only]. default for normal tenants: visible-only. internal users can flip to probe-only.
jonathan: telemetry schema change needed: add fields {"quiet_mode": boolean, "trace_id": string, "sample_policy": string, "probe_tag": string}. we'll need backwards-compat shims in the pipeline so older dashboards don't break.
ravi: pipeline impact: we already version events. plan: emit events with version=v2_probe for quiet mode; downstream consumers can opt in. about double-counting — set dedupe keys to include trace_id + tenant_id so dedupe will drop duplicates.
maria: ops-bot, can you schedule a small experiment with quiet_mode enabled for 100 tenants for 48h? want to validate telemetry and UI stability.
ops-bot: Scheduled: experiment "quiet-mode-alpha" for 100 tenants, duration 48h, start=1752462000, owner=maria. I will post summary at end. :white_check_mark:
jonathan: follow-ups: (1) write console feature flag PR, (2) add pipeline schema docs, (3) create dashboard toggle prototype. i'll take 1 & 3. ashley will handle 2 with product.
ashley: ack. will draft the schema doc and include migration notes for pre-v2 dashboards.
maria: thanks team. if we see any unexpected customer side-effects we abort and revert the experiment immediately. please add alerting on banner-audit writes dropping below baseline.
ravi: will add an internal alert: "banner-audit-write-rate < 50% baseline and quiet_mode_count > 0". also adding a runbook note to the experiment ticket.
jonathan: perfect. keeping this quiet for now until we confirm metrics. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: experiment "quiet-mode-alpha" started at 1752462000. monitoring channel: #experiments.
jonathan: closing thread — will post PR link once open.
